## Display 3D CUBE object  ## THIS ONLY WORKS FOR CUBE

On OBJ_LOOP ANGLEX,ANGLEY,ANGLEZ,fXrot,fYrot,fZrot,pivX,pivY,pivZ,XROTOFFSET,YROTOFFSET,ZROTOFFSET,CAMX,CAMY,CAMZ,moveX,moveY,moveZ,theSCALE, theMode
   ----  Rotation values make the spin happen
   ----  if these are 0 or empty the prorgram does nothing
   ----  values 5,8,3 given in tutorial are crazy high and hideous
   put ANGLEX+fXrot into ANGLEX  ---- 5
   put ANGLEY+fYrot into ANGLEY  ---- 8
   put ANGLEZ+fZrot into ANGLEZ   ---- 3
   focus nothing
   put the objectType of me into thisObj
   if thisObj is "CUBE" then
      send CUBE_LOOP && ANGLEX,ANGLEY,ANGLEZ,fXrot,fYrot,fZrot,pivX,pivY,pivZ,XROTOFFSET,YROTOFFSET,ZROTOFFSET,CAMX,CAMY,CAMZ,moveX,moveY,moveZ,theSCALE, theMode to me
      exit OBJ_LOOP
   end if
   --put "Cone" into thisOBJ  -- xyzCUBEArray is where the data is stored
   do  "put the XYZ"&thisOBJ &"Array  of this stack into OBJArray"
   
   if the xCenter of me is empty then     send setCenterXY to  me
   put the xCenter of me into  CenterX
   put the yCenter of me into CenterY 
   
   put the number of lines of the keys of OBJArray["X"] into verticeCount
   put 0 into LoopIndex
   ----  repeat through each vertice of the object
   Repeat with N=1 To verticeCount  ----<< (number of points of our circle*3)*1.9?   
      
      --if xCheck is empty or ycheck is empty or zCheck is empty then next repeat
      
      ----  Rotation code
      put (getXYZ(thisOBJ,"x",N)-PIVX) into XD
      put (getXYZ(thisOBJ,"y",N)-PIVY) into YD
      put (getXYZ(thisOBJ,"z",N)-PIVZ) into ZD
      ---put ZD into field "Status"
      
      --- remove awful centroid line
      if (XD = 0 and YD = 0) or (XD = 0 and ZD = 0) or (YD = 0 and ZD = 0) then
         put cr &cr after tPoints
         next repeat
      end if
      
      
      ----  read the tutorial if you want to understand what happens here
      put XD*Cos(ANGLEZ) - YD*Sin(ANGLEZ) - XD into ZX
      put XD*Sin(ANGLEZ) + YD*Cos(ANGLEZ) - YD into ZY
      
      put (XD+ZX)*Cos(ANGLEY) - ZD*Sin(ANGLEY) - (XD+ZX) into YX
      put (XD+ZX)*Sin(ANGLEY) + ZD*Cos(ANGLEY) - ZD into YZ
      
      put (YD+ZY)*Cos(ANGLEX) - (ZD+YZ)*Sin(ANGLEX) - (YD+ZY) into XY
      put (YD+ZY)*Sin(ANGLEX) + (ZD+YZ)*Cos(ANGLEX) - (ZD+YZ) into XZ
      
      ---- the code above results in these offsets
      put (YX+ZX) into XROTOFFSET
      put (ZY+XY) into YROTOFFSET
      put (XZ+YZ) into ZROTOFFSET
      
      ----  modifying theScale manually can result in errors, trapped here
      if theScale = 0 then put 0.01 into theScale  ----  no divide by zero
      
      ----  Yes, it's the *SPLAT* code (aka 2D to 3D conversion):
      If theMODE=0 then
         Put ( getXYZ(thisOBJ,"x",N) + XROTOFFSET + CAMX )/theSCALE +MOVEX into X  
         Put ( getXYZ(thisOBJ,"y",N) + YROTOFFSET + CAMY )/theSCALE +MOVEY into Y 
      Else
         Put ( getXYZ(thisOBJ,"z",N) + ZROTOFFSET + CAMZ ) into Z
         Put ( getXYZ(thisOBJ,"x",N) + XROTOFFSET + CAMX )/Z /theSCALE +MOVEX into X 
         Put ( getXYZ(thisOBJ,"y",N) + YROTOFFSET + CAMY )/Z /theSCALE +MOVEY into Y 
      End If
      
      ----  modifying CAMZ manually can result in errors, trapped here
      ----  keep the zoom (camz) from overloading  the x,y values
      if x > 1600 then put 1600 into X
      if y > 1600 then put 1600 into Y
      if x < -1300 then put -1300 into x
      if y < -1300 then put -1300 into y
      
      ----  the x,y values derived above applied to the center of the screen
      put X+CenterX & comma &  Y+CenterY  into curPoint
      
      put cr  &curPoint  after tPoints
   end repeat
   put cr & cr after line 1 of tPoints
   set the points of me to tPoints  
   put  Scene.Variables.Array() into gSceneState
end OBJ_LOOP

## CARD SCRIPT: "Play.Canyon"   DEFENSIVE 3D: CANYON RUN  (11 08 2026)
## Paste this into the script of card "Play.Canyon". The engine (rendering, meshes,
## entities, collisions, FX, HUD, sound, view) lives in the stack script; this card
## holds only the game. The engine sends these to the current card:
##   Game.OnStart  Game.OnUpdate  Game.OnStop  Collision.Hit pA,pB
## Start: Game.Select "Canyon" then Game.Play (or the Title card PLAY button).
##
##   Defensive (2D)                      ->  Canyon run (3D)
##   scrolling mountains + parallax     ->  endless procedural canyon, depth-faded
##   green triangle ship, mouse flies   ->  3D arrow ship flies to the mouse, banks
##   mouse down = missiles              ->  mouse down = twin shots
##   20 random polygon enemies          ->  20 random 3D shapes, same 20 colours
##   enemies: 3-11 destinations, shoot  ->  same, then exit far away or fly past you
##   more enemies every minute (max 10) ->  same: level up, +1000, shapes regenerated
##   3 lives / explosions / score       ->  same, with vector derez + HUD
## WORLD: camera at the origin looking down +Z (+X right, +Y down), sized from the screen.
######################################################################################

global gObjectTransforms
global gSceneObjects
global gCameraYaw
global gCameraPitch
global gViewLeft,gViewTop,gViewRight,gViewBottom
global CenterX,CenterY

local sU, sF -- world unit sized from the screen, and sU/300 for mesh sizes
local sProjK, sProjOffX, sProjOffY, sStepMS = 33 -- from the engine (Engine.Info)
local sCamX = 0, sCamY = 0 -- camera follow offset
local sShipZ, sShipMaxX, sShipMaxY, sShipId, sShipDead = false, sInvulnTicks = 0, sRespawnTicks = 0
local sSegCount, sSegLen, sScroll, sSegFarZ, sCanyonCX, sLastProfile
local sEnemies, sScore = 0, sLives = 3, sLevel = 1, sCanyonTicks = 0, sFireCool = 0
local sGameOverTicks = 0, sMsgTicks = 0

## Defensive's colour list, as hex so glow colours work.
function Canyon.Palette
   return "#D02090,#FF0000,#FF4500,#FFA500,#FFFF00,#7CFC00,#32CD32,#00FF00,#00FFFF,#6495ED," & \
         "#1E90FF,#3399FF,#FF00FF,#00FF7F,#FFC0CB,#FF69B4,#00F5FF,#87CEEB,#E6E6FA,#FFFFFF"
end Canyon.Palette

## Start (or restart) the canyon game. The engine sends this from Game.Play.
on Game.OnStart
   -- A plain camera: no scene spin, no pivot, looking straight down +Z.
   Engine.ResetCamera
   put 0 into sCamX
   put 0 into sCamY
   Canyon.GetProjection
   put Engine.Info("stepMS") into sStepMS

   -- Size everything from the screen: sU = visible half-height at depth 400.
   put (gViewBottom - gViewTop) / 2 into tHalfH
   put (gViewRight - gViewLeft) / 2 into tHalfW
   put tHalfH * 400 / sProjK into sU
   put sU / 300 into sF
   put sU * 0.75 into sShipZ
   put 0.8 * tHalfW * sShipZ / sProjK into sShipMaxX
   put 0.7 * tHalfH * sShipZ / sProjK into sShipMaxY

   -- Clear the old scene.
   Scene.ClearAll
   Particles.Clear
   HUD.Clear
   put empty into sEnemies

   -- Meshes.
   Mesh.Define "Ship", Canyon.ShipMesh()
   Mesh.Define "Shot", Canyon.ShotMesh()
   Mesh.Define "Bullet", Canyon.BulletMesh()
   Canyon.MakeEnemyMeshes

   -- The canyon: sSegCount segments, each sSegLen deep.
   put 10 into sSegCount
   put sU * 0.6 into sSegLen
   put sSegLen / 9 into sScroll
   put 0 into sCanyonCX
   put Canyon.NewProfile() into sLastProfile
   repeat with i = 1 to sSegCount
      put "CanyonSeg" & i into tMeshName
      put Canyon.NewProfile() into tBack
      Mesh.Define tMeshName, Canyon.SegmentMesh(sLastProfile,tBack,sSegLen)
      put tBack into sLastProfile
      put "Canyon_" & i into tKey
      SetObjectPosition tKey,0,0,(i-1)*sSegLen
      SetObjectRotation tKey,0,0,0
      SetObjectRotationSpeed tKey,0,0,0
      SetObjectVelocity tKey,0,0,0
      Scene.Register tMeshName,tKey,Scene.ColorGraphic("#88FF22")
   end repeat
   put sSegCount * sSegLen into sSegFarZ

   -- Rules.
   Collision.ClearRules
   Collision.AddRule "shot","enemy"
   Collision.AddRule "bullet","ship"
   Collision.AddRule "enemy","ship"

   -- Player.
   put 0 into sScore
   put 3 into sLives
   put 1 into sLevel
   put 0 into sCanyonTicks
   put 0 into sFireCool
   put 0 into sGameOverTicks
   Canyon.SpawnShip
   Canyon.ShowHUD
   Canyon.Message "LEVEL 1",60
end Game.OnStart

## The engine's projection numbers (they change with the window size).
on Canyon.GetProjection
   put Engine.Info("projection") into tP
   put item 1 of tP into sProjK
   put item 2 of tP into sProjOffX
   put item 3 of tP into sProjOffY
end Canyon.GetProjection

on Game.OnStop
   HUD.Remove "msg"
end Game.OnStop



## ---------------------------------------------------------------- MESHES

## Arrow-head fighter, nose to +Z (Defensive's green triangle, in 3D).
function Canyon.ShipMesh
   put Mesh.New() into tM
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,0,0,30*sF -- 1 nose
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,-24*sF,5*sF,-12*sF -- 2 left wing
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,24*sF,5*sF,-12*sF -- 3 right wing
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,0,-9*sF,-10*sF -- 4 fin
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,0,4*sF,-8*sF -- 5 belly
   Mesh.AddFace tM,"1 2 4"
   Mesh.AddFace tM,"1 4 3"
   Mesh.AddFace tM,"1 3 5"
   Mesh.AddFace tM,"1 5 2"
   Mesh.AddFace tM,"2 4 3 5"
   return tM
end Canyon.ShipMesh

## A laser bolt: one line along Z.
function Canyon.ShotMesh
   put Mesh.New() into tM
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,0,0,-14*sF
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,0,0,14*sF
   Mesh.AddLine tM,1,2
   return tM
end Canyon.ShotMesh

## Enemy bullet: a 3-line star.
function Canyon.BulletMesh
   put 5 * sF into r
   put Mesh.New() into tM
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,-r,0,0
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,r,0,0
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,0,-r,0
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,0,r,0
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,0,0,-r
   Mesh.AddVertex tM,0,0,r
   Mesh.AddLine tM,1,2
   Mesh.AddLine tM,3,4
   Mesh.AddLine tM,5,6
   return tM
end Canyon.BulletMesh

## 20 random enemy shapes, "Enemy1".."Enemy20" (Defensive's MakeEnemies).
## Called again on every level up (Defensive's RandomizeEnemies).
on Canyon.MakeEnemyMeshes
   repeat with n = 1 to 20
      put (12 + random(14)) * sF into r
      switch random(4)
         case 1
            put Mesh.Transform(MeshPrism(2 + random(6), r, r * 0.6),pi/2,0,0,0,0,0,1) into tM
            break
         case 2
            put MeshPyramid(2 + random(6), r, r * 1.4) into tM
            break
         case 3
            put MeshSphere(r, 2 + random(2), 3 + random(5)) into tM
            break
         default
            -- Diamond: two pyramids base to base.
            put 2 + random(5) into tSides
            put Mesh.Transform(MeshPyramid(tSides, r, r),0,0,0,0,-r/2,0,1) into tM
            put Mesh.Merge(tM, Mesh.Transform(MeshPyramid(tSides, r, r),pi,0,0,0,r/2,0,1)) into tM
      end switch
      Mesh.Define "Enemy" & n, tM
   end repeat
end Canyon.MakeEnemyMeshes

## One cross-section of the canyon: 7 "x,y" points, left rim -> floor -> right rim.
## Jittered for the crunchy look; the centre line wanders left and right.
function Canyon.NewProfile
   add (random(31) - 16) / 100 * sU - sCanyonCX * 0.1 to sCanyonCX
   put max(-0.35 * sU, min(0.35 * sU, sCanyonCX)) into sCanyonCX
   put sCanyonCX into c
   put 0.55 * sU into tFloorW
   put 1.15 * sU into tRimW
   put 0.62 * sU into tFloorY
   put -0.75 * sU into tRimY
   put (tRimY + tFloorY) / 2 into tMidY
   put (tRimW + tFloorW) / 2 + 0.1 * sU into tMidW
   put (c - tRimW + Canyon.J(0.15)) & comma & (tRimY + Canyon.J(0.2)) & cr into tP
   put (c - tMidW + Canyon.J(0.12)) & comma & (tMidY + Canyon.J(0.2)) & cr after tP
   put (c - tFloorW + Canyon.J(0.08)) & comma & (tFloorY + Canyon.J(0.05)) & cr after tP
   put (c + Canyon.J(0.15)) & comma & (tFloorY + 0.06 * sU + Canyon.J(0.05)) & cr after tP
   put (c + tFloorW + Canyon.J(0.08)) & comma & (tFloorY + Canyon.J(0.05)) & cr after tP
   put (c + tMidW + Canyon.J(0.12)) & comma & (tMidY + Canyon.J(0.2)) & cr after tP
   put (c + tRimW + Canyon.J(0.15)) & comma & (tRimY + Canyon.J(0.2)) after tP
   return tP
end Canyon.NewProfile

## Random jitter of +/- pAmount * sU.
function Canyon.J pAmount
   return (random(2001) - 1001) / 1000 * pAmount * sU
end Canyon.J

## One canyon segment between two profiles. Draws the front profile and the long edges
## only (the back profile is drawn by the next segment). Wall faces are pickable.
function Canyon.SegmentMesh pFront,pBack,pLen
   put Mesh.New() into tM
   put the number of lines of pFront into tN
   repeat for each line tPt in pFront
      Mesh.AddVertex tM,item 1 of tPt,item 2 of tPt,0
   end repeat
   repeat for each line tPt in pBack
      Mesh.AddVertex tM,item 1 of tPt,item 2 of tPt,pLen
   end repeat
   repeat with k = 1 to tN - 1
      Mesh.AddFace tM,k && (k+1) && (tN+k+1) && (tN+k)
      Mesh.AddLine tM,k,k+1
   end repeat
   repeat with k = 1 to tN
      Mesh.AddLine tM,k,tN+k
   end repeat
   put false into tM["edgesFromFaces"]
   return tM
end Canyon.SegmentMesh


## ---------------------------------------------------------------- UPDATE (every step)

## Every simulation step (the engine sends this from game.update).
on Game.OnUpdate
   add 1 to sCanyonTicks
   put 0 into gCameraYaw
   put 0 into gCameraPitch
   if sCanyonTicks mod 30 = 0 then Canyon.GetProjection

   Canyon.ScrollCanyon
   Canyon.UpdateShip
   Canyon.UpdateEnemies

   -- Level up every minute (Defensive: timeLevel), up to 10.
   put min(10, 1 + sCanyonTicks div (60 * 1000 div sStepMS)) into tLevel
   if tLevel > sLevel then
      put tLevel into sLevel
      Canyon.MakeEnemyMeshes
      Canyon.AddScore 1000
      Canyon.Message "LEVEL" && sLevel,60
      Sound.Play "Warp"
   end if

   -- Message timer.
   if sMsgTicks > 0 then
      subtract 1 from sMsgTicks
      if sMsgTicks = 0 then HUD.Remove "msg"
   end if

   -- Game over: wait, then leave.
   if sGameOverTicks > 0 then
      subtract 1 from sGameOverTicks
      if sGameOverTicks = 0 then Canyon.EndGame
   end if
end Game.OnUpdate

## Move every segment toward the camera; recycle passed ones to the far end with a
## brand new profile (Defensive scrolled one long mountain; this one never ends).
on Canyon.ScrollCanyon
   subtract sScroll from sSegFarZ
   repeat with i = 1 to sSegCount
      put "Canyon_" & i into tKey
      subtract sScroll from gObjectTransforms[tKey]["z"]
      if gObjectTransforms[tKey]["z"] + sSegLen < 0 then
         put Canyon.NewProfile() into tBack
         Mesh.Define "CanyonSeg" & i, Canyon.SegmentMesh(sLastProfile,tBack,sSegLen)
         put tBack into sLastProfile
         put sSegFarZ into gObjectTransforms[tKey]["z"]
         add sSegLen to sSegFarZ
      end if
   end repeat
end Canyon.ScrollCanyon

on Canyon.SpawnShip
   put Entity.Spawn("Ship",0,0,sShipZ,"#00FF66") into sShipId
   put sU * 0.05 into gObjectTransforms[sShipId]["radius"]
   put false into sShipDead
   -- A moment of safety after (re)spawning: no collision group yet.
   put 45 into sInvulnTicks
end Canyon.SpawnShip

on Canyon.UpdateShip
   if sShipDead then
      subtract 1 from sRespawnTicks
      if sRespawnTicks <= 0 and sGameOverTicks = 0 then
         if sLives > 0 then
            Canyon.SpawnShip
         else
            Canyon.Message "GAME OVER",0
            put 4000 div sStepMS into sGameOverTicks
         end if
      end if
      exit Canyon.UpdateShip
   end if
   if sInvulnTicks > 0 then
      subtract 1 from sInvulnTicks
      if sInvulnTicks = 0 then Collision.SetGroup sShipId,"ship"
   end if

   -- Fly toward the mouse (screen point -> world point at the ship's depth).
   put the mouseH into tMX
   put the mouseV into tMY
   put (tMX - sProjOffX) * sShipZ / sProjK - sCamX into tTX
   put (tMY - sProjOffY) * sShipZ / sProjK - sCamY into tTY
   put max(-sShipMaxX, min(sShipMaxX, tTX)) into tTX
   put max(-sShipMaxY, min(sShipMaxY, tTY)) into tTY
   put gObjectTransforms[sShipId]["x"] into x
   put gObjectTransforms[sShipId]["y"] into y
   put (tTX - x) * 0.25 into dx
   put (tTY - y) * 0.25 into dy
   put x + dx into gObjectTransforms[sShipId]["x"]
   put y + dy into gObjectTransforms[sShipId]["y"]
   -- Bank into turns, pitch with climbs.
   put max(-0.7, min(0.7, -dx / sU * 6)) into gObjectTransforms[sShipId]["rotZ"]
   put max(-0.4, min(0.4, dy / sU * 4)) into gObjectTransforms[sShipId]["rotX"]
   -- The camera follows a little, for parallax.
   put -(x + dx) * 0.35 into sCamX
   put -(y + dy) * 0.25 into sCamY
   Engine.SetCam sCamX,sCamY,0

   -- Fire (Defensive: mouse down = FireMissile).
   if sFireCool > 0 then subtract 1 from sFireCool
   if the mouse is down and sFireCool = 0 then
      put 3 into sFireCool

   put empty into tAlive
   repeat for each line tId in sEnemies
      if gObjectTransforms[tId] is an array then put tId & cr after tAlive
   end repeat
   put tAlive into sEnemies

   if not sShipDead and the number of lines of sEnemies < sLevel + 1 and random(100) <= 4 then

   end if

   repeat for each line tId in sEnemies

   end repeat

on Canyon.SpawnEnemy

   put item n of Canyon.Palette() into tColor
   put Entity.Spawn("Enemy" & n, Canyon.J(0.6), Canyon.J(0.4), sSegFarZ * 0.9, tColor) into tId
   SetObjectRotationSpeed tId,(random(21)-11)/200,(random(21)-11)/200,(random(21)-11)/200

      put 2 into gObjectTransforms[tId]["hp"]
   else
      put 1 into gObjectTransforms[tId]["hp"]
   end if
   put (2 + random(4)) * sU / 300 + sLevel * 0.2 * sF into gObjectTransforms[tId]["spd"]
   put 2 + random(8) into gObjectTransforms[tId]["dests"]
   put 20 + random(40) into gObjectTransforms[tId]["fireCool"]
   put false into gObjectTransforms[tId]["exiting"]
   Collision.SetGroup tId,"enemy"
   Canyon.EnemyNewDest tId
   put tId & cr after sEnemies
   Sound.Play "Enemy"

## an exit: far away, or right past the player.

   if gObjectTransforms[pId]["dests"] > 0 then
      subtract 1 from gObjectTransforms[pId]["dests"]
      put Canyon.J(0.7) into gObjectTransforms[pId]["tx"]
      put Canyon.J(0.45) into gObjectTransforms[pId]["ty"]
      put sShipZ + sU * 0.5 + random(round(sSegFarZ * 0.5)) into gObjectTransforms[pId]["tz"]
   else
      put true into gObjectTransforms[pId]["exiting"]
      put Canyon.J(1) into gObjectTransforms[pId]["tx"]
      put Canyon.J(0.6) into gObjectTransforms[pId]["ty"]
      if random(2) = 1 then
         put -sU into gObjectTransforms[pId]["tz"]
      else
         put sSegFarZ + sU into gObjectTransforms[pId]["tz"]
      end if
   end if

   put gObjectTransforms[pId]["x"] into x
   put gObjectTransforms[pId]["y"] into y
   put gObjectTransforms[pId]["z"] into z
   put gObjectTransforms[pId]["tx"] - x into dx
   put gObjectTransforms[pId]["ty"] - y into dy
   put gObjectTransforms[pId]["tz"] - z into dz
   put sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz) into tDist
   put gObjectTransforms[pId]["spd"] into tSpd
   if tDist <= tSpd then
      if gObjectTransforms[pId]["exiting"] then
         Entity.Kill pId
         exit Canyon.MoveEnemy
      end if
      Canyon.EnemyNewDest pId
   else
      put x + dx / tDist * tSpd into gObjectTransforms[pId]["x"]
      put y + dy / tDist * tSpd into gObjectTransforms[pId]["y"]
      put z + dz / tDist * tSpd into gObjectTransforms[pId]["z"]
   end if

   -- Shoot at the player while in range (Defensive: ActivateBullets).
   if sShipDead or gObjectTransforms[pId]["exiting"] then exit Canyon.MoveEnemy
   if z < sShipZ + sU * 0.4 or z > sSegFarZ * 0.8 then exit Canyon.MoveEnemy
   subtract 1 from gObjectTransforms[pId]["fireCool"]
   if gObjectTransforms[pId]["fireCool"] <= 0 then

   put gObjectTransforms[sShipId]["y"] - pY into dy
   put sShipZ - pZ into dz
   put sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz) into tLen
   if tLen < 1 then exit Canyon.FireBullet
   put sU * (0.025 + sLevel * 0.002) into tSpd
   put Entity.Spawn("Bullet",pX,pY,pZ,"#FFDD55") into tId
   SetObjectVelocity tId,dx / tLen * tSpd,dy / tLen * tSpd,dz / tLen * tSpd
   SetObjectRotationSpeed tId,0.2,0.3,0
   put 200 into gObjectTransforms[tId]["ttl"]
   Collision.SetGroup tId,"bullet",sU * 0.03
   Sound.Play "Bullet"
end Canyon.FireBullet


## ---------------------------------------------------------------- HITS, SCORE, HUD

## The engine sends Collision.Hit to this card first; handling it here (no pass)
## replaces the stack's default rule.
on Collision.Hit pA,pB
   put gObjectTransforms[pA]["group"] into gA
   put gObjectTransforms[pB]["group"] into gB
   -- Put the pair in rule order.
   if gA is "enemy" and gB is "shot" or gA is "ship" then
      put pA into tTemp
      put pB into pA
      put tTemp into pB
      put gObjectTransforms[pA]["group"] into gA
      put gObjectTransforms[pB]["group"] into gB
   end if

   if gA is "shot" and gB is "enemy" then
      Entity.Kill pA
      subtract 1 from gObjectTransforms[pB]["hp"]
      if gObjectTransforms[pB]["hp"] <= 0 then
         Canyon.AddScore 100 + sLevel * 10
         FX.Destroy pB
         Sound.Play "Explode"

      end if
   else if gB is "ship" then

      if gA is "enemy" then

      else

      end if
      Canyon.Crash
   end if
end Collision.Hit

   repeat max(0, sLives) times

   end repeat

on Canyon.Message pText,pTicks

## CARD SCRIPT: "Play.Demo"   THE SEA DEMO  (11 08 2026)
## Paste this into the script of card "Play.Demo".
## Boat and buoy bobbing on a grid sea, a field of drifting rocks, and a laser:
## click to fire, 100 points per rock. Rocks that drift into the boat derez.
## The engine sends these to the current card:
##   Game.OnStart  Game.OnUpdate  Game.OnClick x,y  Game.OnKill key  Game.OnStop
## Collision.Hit is not handled here, so the stack's default rule runs
## (anything with "hp" is destroyed).
## Start: Game.Select "Demo" then Game.Play.
######################################################################################

global gObjectTransforms

local sScore = 0

on Game.OnStart
   -- Back to the editor's camera and the original test objects (cube, cone ...).
   App.ResetScene

   -- Meshes: recipes only, nothing is stored in the stack.
   Mesh.Define "Sea", MeshGrid(6,6,100)
   Mesh.Define "Boat", Demo.BoatMesh()
   Mesh.Define "Rock", MeshPyramid(5,30,50)
   Mesh.Define "Buoy", MeshLathe("0,-30|6,-18|14,0|10,12|0,12", 6)

   Scene.AddObject "Sea","SeaLine",0,260,0,"#2E6F8E"
   Scene.AddObject "Boat","BoatLine",0,245,150,"white"
   Scene.SetBob "BoatLine",4,0.08,0.06
   Scene.AddObject "Buoy","BuoyLine",-180,250,200,"yellow"
   Scene.SetBob "BuoyLine",3,0.12,0.09

   -- A field of rocks, all sharing one "Rock" mesh and one orange graphic.
   repeat 8 times
      get Demo.SpawnRock()
   end repeat

   -- Rocks that drift into the boat are destroyed (stack default Collision.Hit).
   Collision.SetGroup "BoatLine","boat",45
   Collision.AddRule "rock","boat"

   put 0 into sScore
   Demo.ShowScore
end Game.OnStart

## Top the rock field back up every 3 seconds or so.
on Game.OnUpdate
   if Engine.Info("simTick") mod 90 is not 0 then exit Game.OnUpdate
   if Entity.Count("Rock") < 8 then get Demo.SpawnRock()
end Game.OnUpdate

## Click while playing = laser (engine's Weapon.FireAt).
on Game.OnClick pX,pY
   Weapon.FireAt pX,pY
end Game.OnClick

## The laser destroyed something.
on Game.OnKill pKey
   if pKey begins with "Rock" then
      add 100 to sScore
      Demo.ShowScore
   end if
end Game.OnKill

on Game.OnStop
end Game.OnStop

on Demo.ShowScore
   HUD.Set "score","SCORE" && format("%06d", sScore),12,12,14
end Demo.ShowScore

## A drifting, spinning, destructible rock somewhere on the sea (not on the boat).
function Demo.SpawnRock
   put GetObjectPosition("BoatLine","x") into tBoatX
   put GetObjectPosition("BoatLine","z") into tBoatZ
   repeat 10 times
      put random(600) - 300 into x
      put random(600) - 300 into z
      if sqrt((x - tBoatX)^2 + (z - tBoatZ)^2) > 140 then exit repeat
   end repeat
   put Entity.Spawn("Rock", x, 235, z, "orange") into tId
   SetObjectRotation tId,0,random(628)/100,0
   SetObjectRotationSpeed tId,0,(random(21)-11)/1000,0
   SetObjectVelocity tId,(random(13)-7)/10,0,(random(13)-7)/10
   put 1 into gObjectTransforms[tId]["hp"]
   Collision.SetGroup tId,"rock",30
   Scene.SetBounds tId,"-300,300,-300,300"
   return tId
end Demo.SpawnRock

## The boat: lofted hull, box cabin, wire mast, triangle sail. 31 edges.
## Deck at y=0, keel (half-size copy of the deck) at y=+25, mast top at y=-70. Bow to +Z.
function Demo.BoatMesh
   put MeshLoft("0,60|20,25|20,-50|-20,-50|-20,25", 0, "0,30|10,12.5|10,-25|-10,-25|-10,12.5", 25) into tBoat
   put Mesh.Merge(tBoat, Mesh.Transform(MeshBox(24,14,30),0,0,0,0,-7,-15,1)) into tBoat
   -- Mast: wire only.
   Mesh.AddVertex tBoat,0,0,10
   put the result into tFoot
   Mesh.AddVertex tBoat,0,-70,10
   put the result into tTop
   Mesh.AddLine tBoat,tFoot,tTop
   -- Sail: one triangle.
   Mesh.AddVertex tBoat,0,-66,12
   put the result into s1
   Mesh.AddVertex tBoat,0,-8,12
   put the result into s2
   Mesh.AddVertex tBoat,0,-8,45
   put the result into s3
   Mesh.AddFace tBoat,s1 && s2 && s3
   return tBoat
end Demo.BoatMesh

## A fresh "User" group as big as the card (four 2x2 anchors in the corners), then
## every user object moved INTO it without ever touching the group's rect.
## pSkip: a control to leave out (the button running this).
on BuildUserGroup pSkip
   lock screen
   put the width of this card into W
   put the height of this card into H
   
   -- 1. An old "User" group: lift its children out to the card, then delete it.
   if there is a group "User" then
      put the long id of group "User" into tOld
      put the name of tOld into tOldName
      put empty into tKids
      repeat with i = 1 to the number of controls of tOld
         put the long id of control i of tOld into tRef
         if the owner of tRef is tOldName then put the short id of tRef & cr after tKids
      end repeat
      repeat for each line tId in tKids
         put the rect of control id tId into tRect
         relayer control id tId to front of this card
         set the rect of control id tId to tRect
      end repeat
      -- Old anchors go too.
      repeat for each item tA in "ATL,ATR,ABL,ABR"
         if there is a graphic tA then delete graphic tA
      end repeat
      set the cantDelete of tOld to false
      delete tOld
   end if
   
   -- 2. Four invisible anchors in the card's corners, grouped: the group IS the card.
   reset the templateGraphic
   set the style of the templateGraphic to "rectangle"
   set the opaque of the templateGraphic to false
   set the lineSize of the templateGraphic to 0
   set the showBorder of the templateGraphic to false
   create graphic "ATL"
   set the rect of graphic "ATL" to 0,0,2,2
   create graphic "ATR"
   set the rect of graphic "ATR" to W-2,0,W,2
   create graphic "ABL"
   set the rect of graphic "ABL" to 0,H-2,2,H
   create graphic "ABR"
   set the rect of graphic "ABR" to W-2,H-2,W,H
   reset the templateGraphic
   group graphic "ATL" and graphic "ATR" and graphic "ABL" and graphic "ABR"
   put it into tUser
   set the name of tUser to "User"
   set the margins of tUser to 0 -- fit the anchors exactly: 0,0,W,H
   set the lockLoc of tUser to true -- and never resize again
   try
      set the clipsToRect of tUser to true
   catch tErr
   end try
   
   -- 3. Move every user object in, putting each back exactly where it was.
   put empty into tMove
   repeat with i = 1 to the number of controls of this card
      put the long id of control i of this card into tRef
      if word 1 of the owner of tRef is not "card" then next repeat
      if tRef is pSkip then next repeat
      put the short name of tRef into tName
      if tName is among the items of "User,Viewport,AudioPlayers,PauseMenuGroup,OptionsGroup" then next repeat
      if word 1 of tRef is "group" then
         if the backgroundBehavior of tRef then next repeat
      end if
      set the customPropertySet of tRef to empty
      if the HUD of tRef is true then next repeat
      if the Entity of tRef is true then next repeat
      put the short id of tRef & cr after tMove
   end repeat
   repeat for each line tId in tMove
      put the rect of control id tId into tRect
      relayer control id tId to front of group "User"
      set the rect of control id tId to tRect
   end repeat
   set the layer of group "User" to top
   unlock screen
   put "User rect:" && the rect of group "User" && " controls:" && the number of controls of group "User"
end BuildUserGroup

## Make room for glows / shadows around a group's contents WITHOUT moving them.
## Each side grows only as far as an effect actually reaches past the contents.
on PadGroupForGlow pGroupName
   if there is not a group pGroupName then
      answer "No group" && pGroupName
      exit PadGroupForGlow
   end if
   put the long id of group pGroupName into tGroup
   put the name of tGroup into tGroupName -- e.g. group "User", to spot direct children
   
   -- 1. Start from the contents' own bounds.
   put the formattedRect of tGroup into tNeed
   
   -- 2. Grow only where an effect reaches past them.
   repeat with i = 1 to the number of controls of tGroup
      put the long id of control i of tGroup into tRef
      put 0 into tReach
      put the outerGlow of tRef into tFX
      if the keys of tFX is not empty then
         put max(tReach, tFX["size"], tFX["spread"]) into tReach
      end if
      put the dropShadow of tRef into tFX
      if the keys of tFX is not empty then
         put max(tReach, max(tFX["size"], tFX["spread"]) + tFX["distance"]) into tReach
      end if
      if tReach > 0 then
         add 10 to tReach -- a little over, so nothing is clipped
         put the rect of tRef into r
         put min(item 1 of tNeed, item 1 of r - tReach) into item 1 of tNeed
         put min(item 2 of tNeed, item 2 of r - tReach) into item 2 of tNeed
         put max(item 3 of tNeed, item 3 of r + tReach) into item 3 of tNeed
         put max(item 4 of tNeed, item 4 of r + tReach) into item 4 of tNeed
      end if
   end repeat
   
   -- 3. Remember where the direct children are (nested ones move with them).
   put empty into tKeep
   repeat with i = 1 to the number of controls of tGroup
      put the long id of control i of tGroup into tRef
      if the owner of tRef is not tGroupName then next repeat
      put the short id of tRef & tab & the rect of tRef & cr after tKeep
   end repeat
   
   -- 4. Resize the group, then put every child back where it was.
   lock screen
   set the lockLoc of tGroup to true
   set the rect of tGroup to tNeed
   set itemDel to tab
   repeat for each line tLine in tKeep
      set the rect of control id (item 1 of tLine) of this card to item 2 of tLine
   end repeat
   unlock screen
   put "group" && pGroupName && "rect:" && the rect of tGroup & "  loc:" && the loc of tGroup
end PadGroupForGlow
